scenes.title: Seasonal sign-in — desktop
scenes.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen with the seasonal theme selected.
scenes.after_text: The updated sign-in screen with the same theme selected. This static view does not show animation.

scenes.title: Seasonal sign-in — mobile
scenes.before_text: The previous rendered sign-in screen on a narrow viewport.
scenes.after_text: The updated sign-in screen on the same narrow viewport.

scenes.title: Profile avatar controls — mobile
scenes.before_text: The previous avatar settings for the same synthetic account.
scenes.after_text: The updated avatar settings on the same mobile viewport; no photo was uploaded.

scenes.title: Admin profile tools — desktop
scenes.before_text: Classic SQR visibility and the full backup and recovery sections were shown together.
scenes.after_text: A visibility badge, backup tiles, and a quick download replace the wall of text. The off-host warning stays visible; secondary tasks expand on demand.

scenes.title: Admin profile tools — mobile
scenes.before_text: On phones, the recovery forms, tables, and explanations formed one long page.
scenes.after_text: The short phone layout prioritizes creating or downloading a backup. This static capture shows the no-script create control; supported browsers open a dialog.

scenes.title: Request progress in dark mode — desktop
scenes.before_text: Fixed navy blocks behind the progress labels clashed with the Christmas theme's dark green card.
scenes.after_text: Step names and statuses sit directly on the themed card, with readable text and connectors that stop before the labels.

scenes.title: Request progress in dark mode — phone
scenes.before_text: The stacked steps showed the same mismatched navy blocks behind their text.
scenes.after_text: The stacked steps use the card as their background while keeping the vertical progress line and current-step highlight.

scenes.title: Release changelog display
scenes.before_text: The changelog component using the same synthetic release before this change.
scenes.after_text: The updated changelog component using the same synthetic release after this change.

scenes.title: Changelog comparison editor
scenes.before_text: The previous evidence editor for a synthetic release with three changes.
scenes.after_text: The updated evidence editor for the same synthetic release.

scenes.title: Management release preview — without scripts
scenes.before_text: Opening a release preview reveals a comparison already present in the page.
scenes.after_text: Opening the same preview without scripts shows a direct preview link. With scripts enabled, the comparison loads on demand.

scenes.title: Notifications technical evidence — mobile, without scripts
scenes.before_text: Opening a technical report reveals the before and after comparison embedded in the feed.
scenes.after_text: Opening the same report without scripts shows a direct report link. With scripts enabled, the comparison loads on demand.

scenes.title: Management account search — desktop
scenes.before_text: Without scripts, the Accounts pane loaded the complete directory and ignored the search URL.
scenes.after_text: The same URL shows the matching account and result count even without scripts. Cross-page drafts require scripts.

scenes.title: Management account search — phone
scenes.before_text: The phone fallback also loaded the complete directory; search was browser-only.
scenes.after_text: The phone fallback shows the single matching account and keeps the new-account field available.
